description: Start a phone build priced by estimate_release; the files are handed back to the person. A build with a price is charged to the person, so call estimate_release first, tell the person the exact amount it returned, wait for them to agree, and only then call this with that quote_id and the identical confirm_cents. The platform refuses any other combination, so never guess the number and never call this to 'find out' the price. For an Android build, build_app does both steps. Nothing is uploaded to the App Store or Google Play: never tell the person their app was submitted or is being reviewed.

confirm_cents.description: Must equal the quote's `cents` exactly, and the person must have agreed to it.

mode.description: Leave it out. A build is always handed back to the person as files.

project.description: Project id (prj_…) or the app's name (slug). Defaults to the project in deploy.json in the current directory.

name: release
title: Start a phone build
